# PART ONE: DATA PROCESSING

## PARSING VARIABLE VALUES

*Writing a function to **GET()** the URL, parse the JSON, and pull out a list of variables with their values*

```{r}
#Reading in httr and jsonlite packages
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)

#Building the URL and parsing data for 2021
DATA_2021 <- "https://api.census.gov/data/2021/acs/acs1/pums/variables.json"
URL_2021 <- httr::GET(DATA_2021)
parsed_2021 <- fromJSON(rawToChar(URL_2021$content))
variables_2021 <- as_tibble(parsed_2021$data)
variables_2021
```
